title: Dictionaries

exercises.title: Create Map
exercises.description: Create a map ages with keys "Alice" (25), "Bob" (30). Print the map.
hints: Use `SortedDictionary<string,int>` when output must mimic lexicographically sorted dumps.
Build map-style strings with prefixes like `map[` plus ordered `Key:Value` fragments.

exercises.title: Map Lookup
exercises.description: Create map scores = Dictionary{"Math": 95, "Physics": 88}. Look up "Math" and Console.WriteLine the score.
hints: Indexer access `scores["Math"]` throws if absent—fine when keys are guaranteed.

exercises.title: Add to Map
exercises.description: Create empty map names = empty Dictionary. Add entries: "1" -> "One", "2" -> "Two". Print map.
hints: Empty dictionaries still support initializer syntax before printing.

exercises.title: Delete from Map
exercises.description: Create map data = Dictionary{"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3}. Delete "b", then Console.WriteLine the map.
hints: Rebuild string output after mutation to reflect deletions.

exercises.title: Check Key Existence
exercises.description: Create map inventory = Dictionary{"apples": 5, "oranges": 3}. Check if "bananas" exists and Console.WriteLine exists or not found.
hints: Emit exists vs not found exactly per the checker’s expected wording.

exercises.title: Map Length
exercises.description: Create map counts = Dictionary{"one": 1, "two": 2, "three": 3}. Print the number of entries using len().

exercises.title: Iterate Map
exercises.description: Create map grades = Dictionary{"A": 90, "B": 80, "C": 70}. Print each key-value pair.
hints: Iterate `(Key, Value)` pairs with `foreach` over `SortedDictionary` for deterministic order.
Emit `KEY VALUE` pairs separated by newlines.
